hero.eyebrow: A digital health passport for pets
hero.title: Your pet's health history, in one passport.
hero.lead: Vaccines, prescriptions and check-ups in one place. You decide which clinic sees what, and for how long.

howItWorks.title: Ready in three steps
howItWorks.lead: Records live in your account; clinics only see what you allow.
howItWorks.step1Body: Enter their name, species, breed and microchip number if they have one. An estimated age works if you don't know the birth date.
howItWorks.step2Body: Enter the clinic's code, choose what they can see and when the access ends.
howItWorks.step3Body: Check-ups, vaccines and prescriptions build up in your pet's passport, even if you change clinics.

security.title: You're always in control
security.lead: PatiPasaport is designed to make sharing health data safe and transparent.
security.consentBody: Revoke access with one click; from the clinic's next request on, they see nothing.
security.scopeBody: Vaccination history, prescriptions, microchip number, your contact details… each is a separate permission.
security.expiryBody: Every permission has an end date. When it passes, access closes on its own.
security.chipBody: The microchip number is stored encrypted; clinics without microchip access only see the last 4 digits.
security.auditBody: Granting, changing and revoking access are kept in a history that can't be deleted.
security.sessionBody: Repeated failed sign-ins lock the account temporarily, and sessions are renewed regularly.

audiences.title: One passport for everyone
audiences.owners1: All your pets' records in one account
audiences.owners2: See at any time what each clinic can access
audiences.owners3: See upcoming vaccines at a glance
audiences.clinics1: Find patients you have access to by name or microchip number
audiences.clinics2: Patient summary and, if permitted, the owner's contact details on one screen
